name: Critical Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约信息；主要公告涉及股息派发、融资活动及定期财报。最新季度营收同比下降6.9%，净利润同比下降1.7%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not disclose any expansion, reduction, disposal, or new contract information for its business segments in its announcements; the main announcements involved dividend distribution, fundraising activities, and periodic financial reports. The latest quarterly revenue decreased by 6.9% year-on-year, and net profit decreased by 1.7% year-on-year.
